desc_id: Dataran Tinggi Dieng terbentuk oleh kegiatan gunung api, sehingga di sana ada beberapa kawah. Gas di sekitar kawah dapat berbahaya, jadi pengunjung harus mengikuti rambu dan tetap berdiri di belakang pagar pembatas.
desc_en: The Dieng Plateau was formed by volcanic activity, so it has several craters. Gas around a crater can be harmful, so visitors must follow the signs and stay behind the safety fence.
